scenes.title: Choosing Purity in Babylon
scenes.english_text: Long ago, young Daniel and his three friends were taken as captives to the grand city of Babylon. King Nebuchadnezzar offered them rich royal food and wine that had been dedicated to idols. Daniel resolved in his heart not to defile himself and asked for simple vegetables and water. God blessed Daniel and his friends with great health, knowledge, and wisdom.
scenes.tetum_translation: Iha tempu uluk, labarik-mane Daniel no nia belun na'in-tolu hetan lori nu'udar dadur ba sidade boot Babilónia. Liurai Nabukodonozor fó ba sira aihan no tua-uvas liurai nian ne'ebé fo'er tanba dedika ba lululik sira. Daniel determina iha nia laran atu la halo fo'er nia an no husu de'it kuan-tutu no bee. Maromak haraik bensaun ba Daniel no nia belun sira ho isin-di'ak, matenek, no kbiit-laran boot.
scenes.scene_summary: Young Daniel resolves in his heart to remain pure in Babylon by choosing simple food and water.

scenes.title: Interpreting the Statue Dream
scenes.english_text: King Nebuchadnezzar had a terrifying dream about a giant statue made of gold, silver, bronze, iron, and clay, but he forgot the dream! When the king threatened to destroy all the wise men, Daniel prayed earnestly to God. In a night vision, God revealed the mystery to Daniel, who wisely explained the dream and honored the King of Heaven.
scenes.tetum_translation: Liurai Nabukodonozor mehi karradas tebes kona-ba mehi fatuk-estátua boot ne'ebé halo husi osan-mean, osan-mutin, bronze, besik, no rai-tahu, maibé nia haluha mehi ne'e! Bainhira liurai ameasa atu estraga ema matenek hotu, Daniel harohan ho laran boot ba Maromak. Iha mehi kalan nian, Maromak hatudu segredu ne'e ba Daniel, ne'ebé esplika ho matenek mehi ne'e no hahi'i Lalehan nia Liurai.
scenes.scene_summary: God reveals Nebuchadnezzar's forgotten dream of a giant statue to Daniel, saving the wise men.
scenes.nano_banana_prompt: Nano Banana illustration style, a young Hebrew man Daniel wearing a simple beige robe, speaking wisely to King Nebuchadnezzar sitting on a golden throne inside a majestic Babylonian palace. Whimsical fairytale picture book watercolor texture, rich vibrant pastel colors, no text, 4:3 aspect ratio.

scenes.title: Humbling King Nebuchadnezzar
scenes.english_text: Later, King Nebuchadnezzar dreamed of a great tree cut down to a stump. Daniel lovingly warned the proud king that unless he acknowledged God Most High, he would live like a wild animal in the fields. Exactly as Daniel predicted, after seven years of being humbled, the king looked up to heaven, praised God, and had his kingdom restored.
scenes.tetum_translation: Tuir mai, Liurai Nabukodonozor mehi kona-ba ai-hun boot ida ne'ebé harai tiha ba ai-tutu. Daniel aviso ho domin ba liurai foti-an ne'e katak se nia la foti Maromak Aas Liu, nia sei moris hanesan animál fuik iha rai-du'ut laran. Hanesan loloos Daniel fó hatene, tuir tinan hitu haraik-an tiha, liurai hateke ba lalehan, hahi'i Maromak, no simu fali nia reinu.
scenes.scene_summary: Daniel interprets the dream of a felled tree, warning King Nebuchadnezzar to humble himself before God.
scenes.nano_banana_prompt: Nano Banana illustration style, a Hebrew advisor Daniel wearing a beige robe with a brown cloak, pointing gently toward a painting of a giant lush tree being chopped down, while talking to an Egyptian-Babylonian king in a royal courtyard. scenes.title: Handwriting on the Wall
scenes.english_text: Years later, King Belshazzar held a careless banquet using golden cups taken from God's holy Temple. Suddenly, a mysterious human hand appeared and wrote strange words on the wall: 'Mene, Mene, Tekel, Parsin.' Daniel was called to read the message, boldly declaring that God had measured the king's reign and brought it to an end.
scenes.tetum_translation: Tinan barak liu tiha, Liurai Belsazar halo festu la matenek hodi gasta mós kopo osan-mean ne'ebé foti husi Maromak nia Umaklesan Santu. Derrepente, ema nia liman misteriozu ida mosu no hakerek liafuan karradas iha lutu leten: 'Mene, Mene, Tekel, Parsin.' Ema bolu Daniel atu lee mensajen ne'e, no nia deklara ho brani katak Maromak tetu tiha liurai nia ukun no lori nia ba rohan.
scenes.scene_summary: Daniel interprets the mysterious handwriting on the wall during King Belshazzar's banquet.
scenes.nano_banana_prompt: Nano Banana illustration style, an older Hebrew prophet Daniel with a silver beard standing boldly before a grand banquet table, pointing at glowing golden words written on a stone palace wall. Whimsical fairytale picture book watercolor texture, rich vibrant pastel colors, no text, 4:3 aspect ratio.

scenes.title: Jealous Plot of the Officials
scenes.english_text: Under the new King Darius, Daniel was made a top governor because of his exceptional spirit. The other jealous leaders tried to find something wrong with Daniel's work, but he was completely trustworthy. Knowing Daniel loved God, they tricked King Darius into signing a law forbidding anyone to pray to any god or man except the king for thirty days.
scenes.tetum_translation: Iha Liurai Dario foun nia okos, Daniel sai governadór boot tanba nia kbiit-laran exepsiunál. Lider laran-moras sira seluk koko hetan sala ruma iha Daniel nia servisu, maibé nia ema laran-metin tebes. Tanba hatene Daniel domin Maromak, sira lohi Liurai Dario atu assina leis ida ne'ebé bandu ema hotu atu harohan ba maromak ka ema seluk so ba liurai de'it ba loron tolu-nulu.
scenes.scene_summary: Jealous officials trick King Darius into passing a law forbidding prayer to anyone except the king.
scenes.nano_banana_prompt: Nano Banana illustration style, sneaky Babylonian officials whispering secretly while standing outside a grand palace gate under a sunny sky. Whimsical fairytale picture book watercolor texture, rich vibrant pastel colors, no text, 4:3 aspect ratio.

scenes.title: Praying Three Times a Day
scenes.english_text: Even though Daniel knew about the new decree, he went straight home to his upstairs room. With his windows open toward Jerusalem, Daniel knelt down and prayed to God three times a day, giving thanks just as he had always done. The jealous officials watched him and reported Daniel to the heartbroken king.
scenes.tetum_translation: Maski Daniel hatene tiha ukun-fuan foun ne'e, nia la'o diretu ba nia uma iha kuartu li'ur. Ho janella sira nakloke ba Jeruzalém sorin, Daniel hakne'uk no harohan ba Maromak loron ida dala tolu, fó agradese hanesan beibeik nia halo. Lider laran-moras sira haree nia no husu liurai laran-triste atu kastiga Daniel.
scenes.scene_summary: Daniel faithfully continues praying to God three times a day by his window facing Jerusalem.
scenes.nano_banana_prompt: Nano Banana illustration style, a faithful elderly Hebrew man Daniel kneeling in prayer with hands folded by an open arched window overlooking a city landscape at sunset. Whimsical fairytale picture book watercolor texture, rich vibrant pastel colors, no text, 4:3 aspect ratio.

scenes.title: Rescued from the Lions' Den
scenes.english_text: King Darius tried everything to save Daniel, but the law could not be changed, so Daniel was thrown into a pit of fierce lions. Early the next morning, the king ran to the den and called out anxiously. Daniel joyously answered, 'My God sent His angel and shut the lions' mouths!' Daniel emerged without a single scratch.
scenes.tetum_translation: Liurai Dario koko buat hotu atu salva Daniel, maibé leis la bele troka, nune'i soe Daniel ba kuak-laran ne'ebé nakenu ho leão hirus sira. Iha dadeer-saan tuir mai, liurai halai ba kuak laran no bolu ho ta'uk. Daniel hatán ho haksolok, 'Ha'u-nia Maromak haruka Nia anju no taka leão sira-nia ibun!' Daniel sai mai sora kanek ki'ik ida duni.
scenes.scene_summary: God sends an angel to shut the mouths of the lions, miraculously protecting Daniel in the den.
scenes.nano_banana_prompt: Nano Banana illustration style, an elderly Hebrew prophet Daniel standing calmly inside a stone cave, surrounded by gentle, friendly lions sleeping peacefully while a radiant angel with glowing wings stands beside him. Whimsical fairytale picture book watercolor texture, rich vibrant pastel colors, no text, 4:3 aspect ratio.

scenes.title: Proclaiming God's Eternal Kingdom
scenes.english_text: Overjoyed, King Darius ordered Daniel to be pulled out of the den and issued a new decree to all nations: 'Everyone must honor and fear the God of Daniel, for He is the living God whose kingdom will never be destroyed!' Daniel prospered throughout the reign of Darius and Cyrus, shining as a faithful witness of God.
scenes.tetum_translation: Ho haksolok boot, Liurai Dario haruka foti Daniel sai husi kuak laran no hamosu ukun-fuan foun ba nasaun hotu: 'Ema hotu terus hatudu respeitu no ta'uk ba Daniel nia Maromak, tanba Nia mak Maromak moris ne'ebé Nia reinu la bele harai ba nafatin!' Daniel buras iha Dario no Ciro nia ukun laran tomak, nabilan nu'udar sasin laran-metin Maromak nian.
scenes.scene_summary: King Darius issues a royal decree honoring the living God, and Daniel prospers as a faithful witness.
scenes.nano_banana_prompt: Nano Banana illustration style, an elderly Hebrew prophet Daniel standing happily beside King Darius on a palace balcony while the king holds a royal decree before a cheering crowd. Whimsical fairytale picture book watercolor texture, rich vibrant pastel colors, no text, 4:3 aspect ratio.

reflection.core_lesson_en: Daniel shows us that when we remain faithful to God in daily prayer and stay pure, God protects us and uses our brave faith to show His power to the world.
reflection.core_lesson_tet: Daniel hatudu mai ita katak bainhira ita hela laran-metin ba Maromak iha orasaun loron-loron nian no mamuk husi aat, Maromak proteje ita no gasta ita-nia fiar brani atu hatudu Nia kbiit ba mundu.
reflection.discussion_question_en: When your friends press you to do something wrong or stop praying, how can you stay brave and choose to obey God like Daniel did?
reflection.discussion_question_tet: Bainhira ó-nia belun sira urje ó atu halo buat aat ka para harohan, oinsá ó bele hela brani no hili atu halo tuir Maromak hanesan Daniel halo?
